risks.risk: The engine may be a used or second-hand unit rather than a new original equipment unit (OE).
risks.proof: A photo of the engine's identification plate (usually on the side or front).

risks.risk: The engine may have internal mechanical damage or be missing essential components like the crankshaft or camshafts.
risks.proof: A video of the engine being tested with a compression tester.

risks.risk: The engine may be a different model than the one being sold (e.g., a 3.6L vs a 4.0L).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine's identification plate showing the model and displacement.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest-spec model for this engine type

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine's identification plate showing the model and displacement.
Video of the engine being tested with a compression tester.
Photo of the engine with the transmission or stand removed to see the crankshaft and camshafts.
